q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT FOLLOWER, NUM FROM (SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWER, (SELECT COUNT(F2.FOLLOWEE) FROM FOLLOW F2 WHERE F2.FOLLOWEE = F1.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F1) AS S WHERE S.NUM > 0 ORDER BY FOLLOWER ASC

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 groups by FOLLOWEE and then orders by FOLLOWEE, while Q2 groups by FOLLOWER and then orders by FOLLOWER. The difference arises when there are multiple followers for the same followee, as Q1 will count each follower for the same followee as a separate group, while Q2 will count all followers for the same followee as a single group.
